summary_1line: Arjuna cuts down surrounding kings and advances toward Bhishma as multiple warriors converge, while the Pandavas unite to challenge the nearly unshakable grandsire.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna on his white-steeded chariot stands amid a storm of arrows, cutting down the bows of surrounding kings as bodies fall across the battlefield.
Bhishma stands calm and immovable on his chariot while all five Pandava brothers converge against him in battle.
Yudhishthira angrily rebukes Sikhandin on the battlefield after Bhishma cuts down Sikhandin’s weapon.
